title: #175 Overburden
prompt: Nowadays, more and more people believed that overburden can help complete higher quality in achievements. For example, professional teachers, coaches believe that this applies to students and athletes, on the individual and national level. What is your point of view? Give examples to support it.

modelPlan.focus: Discuss whether overburdening leads to higher quality achievements by examining its effects on individuals and national levels, supported by examples.
outline: Introduction: Present the topic and state the thesis.
Body 1: Explain the positive effects of overburdening, such as dedication and discipline, using examples like athletes and students.
Body 2: Highlight potential negative consequences, like diminishing returns and physiological limits, using examples from education and sports.
Conclusion: Summarize the arguments and present a balanced viewpoint.
keyArguments: Overburdening can enhance performance by pushing individuals to their limits, but it can also lead to burnout and decreased efficiency.
While dedication and effort are crucial, there is a point where overexertion becomes counterproductive, affecting both individual and national achievements.
